17 Aruba hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. One snapshot on September 29, 2026 for Nov 3 to Nov 5, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Aruba hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 17 Aruba hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Evendo at 2, KAYAK.com at 2, Traveluro at 2, Agoda at 1, Barcelo.com at 1, Billabook.com at 1, Bookhotel.direct at 1, Booking.com at 1 and 3 other sites at 3 between them. These are the Aruba rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Aruba hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 13% ($52 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 11% at Holiday Inn Resort Aruba-Beach Resort & Casino by IHG to 29% at Caribbean Palm Village Resort. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
